note: NIIMBOT onboarding research draft (Awin 44209 'NIIMBOTS (US)'), 2026-11-25. Proposed new category 'label-printer': ("Label printers", "Thermal label makers for home and product labels, and 4 x 6 shipping-label printers for online sellers."). STORE HOST: Awin's default link lands on niimbots.com (Shopify, store niimbot-store.myshopify.com), but in a real browser niimbots.com JS-redirects every page to the headless store www.niimbot.com/us (Nuxt front end; checkout hosts listed in its config: niimbots.com, niimbot-store.myshopify.com, pay.niimbot.com). The redirect drops all query parameters (awc, sv1, variant), sends some product URLs to a different listing (B21) or to the home page (both D110 listings), and niimbot.com/us runs its own affiliate program pages. Whether Awin attribution survives the hop is NOT verified; settle that with NIIMBOT/Awin before publishing. Records therefore use niimbot.com/us product URLs (where shoppers end up); prices there matched the Shopify cart. Cart tests ran from niimbots.com/cart.js (a no-JS page on the Shopify origin) because tools/codecheck_browser.py's product-page tab is redirected off Shopify. No Awin codes; NEW10 is printed on the US store (product pages and pop-up) and took 10% off all three printers. The store's #1 best-selling printer is the M2 thermal-transfer model ($89.99+); B21, B1 and D110 were picked per the brief's model class. Cart tests in growth/focus/offers/data/niimbot-2026-11-25-carttests.jsonl.

records.name: NIIMBOT B1 2-Inch Bluetooth Thermal Label Maker (203 dpi, 20-50 mm labels, inkless, USB-C rechargeable)
specs: Direct thermal, 203 dpi (no ink, toner or ribbon)
20-50 mm labels (23-54 mm liner); 48 mm effective print width; 20-200 mm print length
Bluetooth (NIIMBOT app, iOS/Android) and USB with a computer driver; no multi-device Bluetooth
1,500 mAh built-in battery, USB-C, 5 V / 1 A input; runtime not stated by NIIMBOT
Printer with one roll of 50 × 30 mm labels (Standard set); 3-roll sets cost $41.98
NIIMBOT B1-compatible rolls; the app identifies the label size automatically
Same listing; B1 Pro adds 300 dpi and black-and-red printing on compatible labels, $33.99
records.warranty: NIIMBOT gives label maker main units a 2-year warranty from purchase or activation, covering manufacturing defects under normal use, for products bought directly from niimbot.com/us with dated proof of purchase and a valid serial number; claims start by email to serviceus@niimbot.com. Damage from non-NIIMBOT consumables is excluded.
records.returns: NIIMBOT accepts returns of orders placed on niimbot.com/us within 30 calendar days of delivery if the item is in original condition; NIIMBOT pays return shipping and refunds the full price for quality problems, while for other returns the buyer pays return shipping and original shipping is not refunded. Opened label rolls and ribbons are not returnable without a quality problem.
records.summary: A pocketable 2-inch thermal label maker that prints labels 20 to 50 mm wide from a phone over Bluetooth, or from a computer over USB, with no ink. NIIMBOT sells it for $23.99 with one roll of 50 × 30 mm labels.
records.fit: Suits home organizing, pantry and storage labels, price tags and small product labels up to 2 inches wide. Anyone printing 4 × 6 inch shipping labels needs a 4-inch printer instead, such as the MUNBYN RW403B ($74.99 at munbyn.com); NIIMBOT's FAQ says the B1 cannot print them.
caveats: NIIMBOT's FAQ says a standard 4 × 6 inch shipping label is too large for the B1 (labels are 20-50 mm wide).

The B1 identifies NIIMBOT label rolls automatically, and NIIMBOT's own FAQ asks for labels 'explicitly marked for the B1'; whether generic rolls work is not stated by NIIMBOT for this model, and its warranty excludes damage from non-NIIMBOT consumables.
Battery runtime and charging time are not stated by NIIMBOT.
The $35.99 strike-through price is NIIMBOT's own list price; the same B1 appears under several NIIMBOT listings at $23.99 to $26.99.
NIIMBOT's welcome code NEW10 took 10% off this printer in NIIMBOT's US cart on 2026-11-25; NIIMBOT's banner describes it as a first-order ('launch order') code.

records.summary: A retro-styled 2-inch thermal label printer that prints labels 20 to 50 mm wide from the NIIMBOT phone app or from Windows and Mac desktop software, with no ink. It costs $52.79 on NIIMBOT's US store with one roll of labels.
records.fit: Suits craft sellers, market stalls and home organizers who want a desk-friendly 2-inch label printer that also works from a computer. Buyers who only need simple labels from a phone can spend less on the NIIMBOT B1 ($23.99 at niimbot.com/us), and 4 × 6 inch shipping labels need a 4-inch printer such as the MUNBYN RW403B ($74.99).
caveats: NIIMBOT's page contradicts itself on resolution: the spec table lists 300 dpi while its FAQ says the B21 Pro 'upgrades the resolution to 300 dpi'; Creative Bloq (Ian Dean, April 2023) reviewed the B21 as a 203 dpi printer whose images 'can look pixelated'.
NIIMBOT's FAQ says third-party labels without a compatible RFID chip may not be recognized correctly, affecting label detection, positioning and printing.
There is no automatic cutter; labels are torn off by hand (Creative Bloq), and Creative Bloq also lists 'some in-app purchases' in the NIIMBOT app as a drawback.
Battery runtime is not stated by NIIMBOT.
NIIMBOT's welcome code NEW10 took 10% off this printer in NIIMBOT's US cart on 2026-11-25; NIIMBOT's banner describes it as a first-order ('launch order') code.

records.summary: A palm-sized Bluetooth label maker that prints 12 mm-wide thermal labels from the NIIMBOT phone app, with no ink or tape cassette. NIIMBOT sells it for $15.99 with one roll of 12 × 40 mm labels.
records.fit: Suits name labels, school supplies, jars, cables and drawer labels where a half-inch label is enough and printing from a phone is fine. Anyone who wants labels up to 2 inches wide or printing from a computer should look at the NIIMBOT B1 ($23.99) or B21 ($52.79) instead.
